text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
BARLEY SALE - The Cyprus Grain Commission accepted Soufflet France's tender for 25,000 tonnes of feed barley at $142.44 a tonne C&F. Shipment would be through Limassol port.
SOYMEAL SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation bought 40,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal from G. Premjee at $317.14 a tonne C&F, NLCF said.
WHEAT SALE - Tunisia purchased five lots of 25,000 tonnes each of soft wheat for April-June shipment at prices ranging from $166.87 to $169.47 per tonne C&F at a tender on Friday.

WHEAT SALES - South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd on Friday said it bought 24,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp. A Daehan official said shipment was set for May 1-30 to the western port of Inchon.

- South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd on Friday bought a total of 22,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Nichimen Corp, traders said. Shipment was set for April 10-May 10 to Pusan.
WHEAT AND SOYBEAN TENDER - A Philippine firm on Friday rejected offers for the supply of 23,000 tonnes U.S. wheat and 15,000 tonnes of soybeans due to high prices, traders said.
WHEAT TENDER - News was awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for May delivery, exporters said.
- The CCC is seeking up to 25,550 tonnes of wheat for donation to Jordan and Yemen for April 1-25 shipment.

BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said Friday it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale not later than April 30. The board said the barley was five percent more or less, seller's option.
- Iran will tender for the import of 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley on March 17, European grain traders said Thursday. The barley is for shipment in May.

CORN TENDER - The CCC said it would seek up to 4,620 tonnes of No. 2 or better yellow corn under its export program for Guatemala. Offers were due on March 19 and the shipment dates were slated for April 3-27.

RICE TENDER - Costa Rica will seek on March 19 a total of 30,000 tonnes optional origin rough rice which would likely be from the United States or Argentina, U.S. exporters and trade sources said. One U.S. exporter said he believed the paddy rice was slated for June arrival while another said it was set for May.

MARKET TALK - Philippine grains importers are expected to shy away from the U.S. market and shift to other sources of wheat and soybeans if prices remain at current high levels next week, traders said Friday.
... Belarus plans to buy 200,000 tonnes of hard wheat in 1997 against 500,000 tonnes of wheat purchased in 1996, the deputy chief of the Agriculture Ministry's crop division said.
